title: 대충 알아서 새 기능 하나 더 만들어줘. CEO가 생각해서 팀에 나눠줘.
description:
CEO clarified this from a chat-only request.

Original user request:
대충 알아서 새 기능 하나 더 만들어줘. CEO가 생각해서 팀에 나눠줘.

CEO interpretation
- Outcome: 대충 알아서 새 기능 하나 더 만들어줘. CEO가 생각해서 팀에 나눠줘.
- Source: user chat request
- Company: 한국어 채팅 CEO 검증

Execution approach
- Clarify the vague request into a goal and success criteria.
- Split the work into branchable slices.
- Assign slices to the best-fit agents in the company roster.
- Keep QA and CEO approval as separate checks before final delivery.

Success criteria:
- The CEO restates the user request as a clear outcome before execution starts.
- The company creates concrete issues with owners, acceptance criteria, and review expectations.
- Specialist agents receive work that matches their role instead of a raw vague chat message.
- The final result is verified and any remaining risk is visible to the CEO.
